market.question: Was Barron Trump involved with the $DJT token?
market.resolutionText:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a preponderance of evidence suggests that Barron Trump was involved in the creation of the Solana token $DJT. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".  

Determination as to whether Barron was involved in the creation of $DJT will be made by this market's decentralized resolver, UMA, and will take into account all available evidence as of 12 PM ET, June 23.

label.marketTitle: Was Barron Trump involved with the $DJT token?
label.whatHappened: UMA voters overwhelmingly resolved NO, finding the 'preponderance of evidence' available on June 23, 2024 did not show Barron's involvement (~$1M+ wagered). Polymarket then OVERRULED its own oracle, publicly stating Barron was involved 'in some way' / 'conclusively,' provided no public evidence, and refunded YES holders. This is the only known case where Polymarket contradicted UMA's verdict.
